verdict.rationale: The pack never documents a library of prebuilt, vendor-maintained app integrations, nor how many apps Make covers. The material present does not qualify: custom-app building components are developer building blocks, the connections API only lists existing connections, and webhooks and the MCP server are adjacent features. This story fits an automation platform, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can connect to thousands of apps through prebuilt, vendor-maintained integrations
